name: Internals
addressFormat: file#export, or a resource with its kind, e.g. src/orders/service.ts#placeOrder, table:orders, queue:emails, https://api.stripe.com

decisionChecklist.question: What are the layers or boundaries (handlers → services → data), and which modules may call which?
Where does state live (database, cache, memory, files), and which store is the source of truth for each kind of data?
How do errors travel between modules: thrown, returned as values, or logged and swallowed?
What runs in the background (jobs, queues, timers, events), and what happens when it fails: retried, dead-lettered, or lost?
Which multi-step writes must succeed or fail together, and what undoes a partial one (transactions, compensation, nothing)?
Which external services does it depend on, and what happens when each one is slow, down or returns an error?
Where does configuration come from (env, files, flags), and what happens when a value is missing?
How would someone notice a failure in production: logs, metrics, alerts, or not at all?
